responsibility: This implementation module provides character I/O on stdin, stdout, and stderr by switching between FIO-buffered operations and direct libc read/write calls according to per-file-descriptor raw mode state. It also manipulates terminal attributes through the termios wrapper to enter or leave raw mode and to toggle echo, flushing FIO output streams when needed, so it serves as the console/terminal front end above FIO and below higher-level text I/O modules.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation half of IO, containing the stdin/stdout/stderr dispatch between FIO buffering and direct libc calls, along with raw-mode and echo changes through termios, which are only declared in IO.def.
